runs.name: verdict-always-accepts
runs.defect: the trailer comparison's branch is a NOP: every frame is answered 0x06 and run

runs.name: trailer-high-byte-unchecked
runs.defect: the trailer comparison ORs R0 with itself, so only the low CRC byte is compared

runs.name: crc-not-cleared-at-the-count
runs.defect: the count handler no longer clears PM_CRC, so a retry after a rejected frame carries the old frame's residue

runs.name: rx-bit-period-wrong
runs.defect: the receiver's bit period is 466 cycles, not 434

runs.name: rx-reads-ui-in-bit-0
runs.defect: the receiver masks ui_in[0] instead of ui_in[1]

runs.name: tx-stop-bit-too-short
runs.defect: the reply's stop bit is padded for 82 cycles, not 171

runs.name: handover-drops-the-guard-last
runs.defect: the hand-over clears uio_out before UIO_OD and UIO_DIR: for two cycles every uio pin drives low
